name: Dallae
source:
[i]“I’d rather die than be on the losing end.”[/i]

Member of [i]Eclipse[/i] / Illusion manipulation

Haesu’s partner, who uncovered the hidden truth behind the indiscriminate terror incident, holds Haesu in special regard due to their unique bond that has lasted since childhood. However, toward others, she remains indifferent and often acts with cruelty.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280020/Eclipse__Special_Forces/]Steam[/url]]
